verdict.rationale: Statsig documents a Console API, described as a CRUD API that performs the actions available in the web console without using the UI. It also documents an HTTP API for fetching gate, experiment and config values and logging events without an SDK. Together these let a programmatic consumer drive the product. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), evidence detail on endpoint coverage and auth, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
